popup.fishery.solarSymbioticValue: Inside a solar site; kept because the authorities recognize it as aquaculture or there is evidence of fish ponds
popup.fishery.satelliteNote: ⓘ 10 m resolution water-body blobs, not outlines of individual ponds; the missed-label candidates include a few false positives (solar panels, detention ponds, etc.)
popup.fishery.moaConfirmed: Confirmed as aquaculture by the NLSC national land-use survey
popup.fishery.moaUnverified: Not confirmed by NLSC; it may be a new pond or not yet in NLSC data (kept under a rescue-rather-than-exclude rule)
popup.fishery.moaAmbiguous: Questionable: matched {hits}, but not confirmed by NLSC
popup.fishery.moaSolar: Fishery-solar co-location (solar panels over fish ponds)
popup.fishery.moaMountain: Suspected terrain shadow (judged by slope or forest); may not be a real fish pond
popup.fishery.unionBoth: Detected by both the old satellite version and the official-label version; highest confidence
popup.fishery.unionMoaOnly: Detected only by the official-label version (newly recovered; missed by the old version)
popup.fishery.unionOsmOnly: Detected only by the old OSM version (not covered by the official-label version)
